worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.summary: Close in and steal the target's HP with a kiss; restores over three quarters of the damage dealt - the stickiest mouthful of the family.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.use.0: Sip a foe's breath back at close range
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.use.1: Hold a low health line with the shortest kiss
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.descripti: The kiss deals about %1$s special damage, of which %2$s is restored to the user.
Kiss reach %1$s blocks (also the real range), hit radius %2$s blocks.
About %1$s hearts burst at the point of contact.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.swoon.on: Swooning kiss: healing share x1.22, but power x0.88 and a longer wind-up and cooldown - the sustain choice.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.swoon.off: Light peck: power x1.12, healing x0.9 and a faster cast - the burst choice.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s s wind-up it costs %4$s PP; recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.growth.0: From level %1$s the kiss power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.growth.1: From level %1$s the kiss power rises to %2$s and the drain share to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.preferenc: On: healing share x1.22, but power x0.88, wind-up +3 and cooldown +5 - good for sustain. Off: power x1.12, healing x0.9 and a faster cast - good for burst.
